# annotation target span

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:annotationTargetSpan`](gmeow-annotationTargetSpan.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/annotationTargetSpan>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notes`](../../slices/notes.md)

An optional anchored span within the annotation target — a text quote, position, or fragment selector. Non-functional: an annotation may reference multiple spans (e.g. several disjoint highlights in the same document). Reuses [`EvidenceSpan`](../classes/gmeow-EvidenceSpan.md) and its selector properties; no second selector model is minted.
